notes.title: Minor Bugfixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
After releasing the game, we still continue our development

We fixed some minor issues that can make your game process more comfortable

Enjoy!

notes.title: Sanity Loops Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
We are glad to announce that our game is ready for release.

On September 16, 2025, the game will be launched on the platform.
We’ve put a lot of work into the game and added exciting mechanics to make the gameplay more diverse.

We don’t want to say too much — instead, we’d love to see feedback from players, as it will help us grow in the future.

Thank you all, and we hope you really enjoy it!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest Update
notes.notes:
Hi! We made a huge update for Demo Version (During we making full version)



1. Speed of dialogs increased, now it looks more pleasant

2. Animations of characters slowed on 50%

3. Tutorial in kiosk - now can be watched multiple times

4. Bug with jumpscares - fixed, some pcs (no idea how it depends) ignore 1st jumpscare in forest scene

5. Add some translations + fixed some translations :)

6. Work with light in game, I think it gives cool vibes

7. Decreased light in some scenes

8. Get a  new friend 'JYLPO' - really good guy, that making cool songs :)



And also we are doing full version of the game :)



Please wishlist the game, and wait for full release! 
Thank you everyone who participate in development / record videos etc.

You do a lot for us!



P.S. You can watch updated trailer for full version (Not final version) 

Leave a comment and subscribe!

notes.title: Game Change Update
notes.notes:
​This is game change update, we implemented a lot of staff, thank you everyone who recorded videos, your suggestions just here!


 Radio music
 Reworked main location
 Reworked last location (at home)
 Some translation fixes
 Light fixes
 Added some interesting references!
 Easter Eggs!!!​


So everyone who already played, just HIGHLY recommend to play again, it's different demo now, where you experience more interesting things

Please add game to Wishlist, to do not skip full version!
When we have 1 week to release full game, we will share 10 keys for free, but about this later :)

notes.title: User feedback update
notes.notes:
So guys, from Youtube videos and user comments we made HUGE updates:

1. Ambient music, now depends on place, street, kiosk etc.
2. We added more jumpscares :))))) Want to add them to Full version, Demo was like about story etc.
3. Radio!!! Now you can listen to radio in kiosk, music is so great, believe me

This most important staff that was added, you can download and check it on steam!

notes.title: Weekend Update
notes.notes:
​We made a great progress on Sanity Loops
Based on user activity and recorded videos on Youtube, we made some hotfixes, such as:
[olist]
 Improved Camera on low fps
 Added gif tutorial how to interact with shop
 Made generator quiz more interesting, hover items now more easy (it's good, because before buttons were so small)
 Light fix on last scene, it's pretty important, thank you TmoniYT​ for support (You can find him on Youtube)
 Improved mouse sensitivity (I am working on Mac, other teammates on Windows) - So we lost a lot of time why sensitivity on Windows is different, compare to MacOS, answer - no idea, unity just works like thisYoutube)
 Fixed some textures, UVs to make game more optimized
[/olist]

So we did it, to make Demo more interesting, we will continue to improve that next week, so this weekend was really cool, we got a lot of feedback, and fixed a lot of important staff.

Your support is a treasure!
